description: This file contains a simple FastAPI application with route handlers, dependency overrides, and test cases demonstrating dependency overriding behavior.

methods.name: common_parameters(q: str | None = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Asynchronous dependency function that provides common query parameters (q, skip, limit) for endpoints.

methods.name: read_items(commons: dict = Depends(common_parameters))
methods.description: Endpoint handler for GET /items/ that uses dependency injection to access common parameters.

methods.name: read_users(commons: dict = Depends(common_parameters))
methods.description: Endpoint handler for GET /users/ that also uses dependency injection for common parameters.

methods.name: override_dependency(q: str | None = None)
methods.description: Asynchronous function to override the common_parameters dependency, changing skip and limit values.

methods.name: test_override_in_items()
methods.description: Test case verifying the behavior of the /items/ endpoint with dependency override.

methods.name: test_override_in_items_with_q()
methods.description: Test case verifying /items/ with a query parameter q and dependency override.

methods.name: test_override_in_items_with_params()
methods.description: Test case verifying /items/ with multiple query parameters and dependency override.

ctags.name: common_parameters
ctags.pattern: /^async def common_parameters(q: str | None = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100):$/
ctags.signature: (q: str | None = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
